summary: Engineering plan written: every spec decision mapped to a file, 12 risks each with a detection path, 13 pre-flight gates, ADR-0021 referenced. No blocking open question.

Lineup column shipped end to end. Every gate passes at 100 percent coverage. Two plan deviations: the migration is nullable because Aurora DSQL rejects every constraint on ADD COLUMN, and on a phone the column sits on the artist line because inline it collapsed the title to one character. One ratified metric remains unmet and needs a product call: a twenty character title truncates at 360 px, and did so before this branch added a column.

The implementation worktree branch merged into the designated branch with no conflict on any of its 54 paths. The blueprint index was stale after the merge and was regenerated. eslint over apps/pragma and tsc --noEmit in apps/pragma both pass on the merge commit.

summary: Every gate passes: eslint, prettier, typecheck, knip, vocabulary, convention-drift, blueprint indexing, doc links, and the full pragma suite at 199 files and 1988 tests with 100 percent per file on all four axes. No dependency was added anywhere in the repository and the bass glyph's two fretboard edges are exactly parallel at slope -1. Every implementation-bearing spec decision landed and the three highest plan risks each have a named back-e2e case. Two non-behavioural blockers: a dead maximumVisibleLineupMembers export that knip and the coverage gate both miss because its own test is its only consumer, and a FollowsBlueprint marker on InstrumentsList naming organism-query-owning when the file calls no query hook. The unmet 360 px title metric is a visual-validation row and a product call, not scored here.

Both validation blockers closed and nothing else touched. The dead maximumVisibleLineupMembers export, its two constants, its only caller in its own sibling test and MemberLineup's never-passed maximumVisible prop are gone. The InstrumentsList marker now names organism-presentational, which is what the component is: it calls no query hook and takes every value as a prop from InstrumentsPage. Eslint, prettier, tsc, knip, the core suite at 1824 tests and the per-file coverage gate all pass.

The fix round merged into the designated branch. One conflict, in this journal: the validation FAIL line on the branch and the implementation-02 line on the worktree side were both appended at the end, and both are kept in the order the events happened. The three code paths merged clean. The validation artifacts left uncommitted in the working tree were committed first, as 434a271a, so the branch carries the verdict that asked for this round. eslint over apps/pragma, tsc --noEmit in apps/pragma, blueprint-indexing --check and convention-drift --check all pass on the merged tree.
